subject: Land #1893, #1892, #1890 (green; DR-037) — the Mac cannot
body:
Three Mac-lane PRs are green and waiting only on the landing step the cloud owns under DR-037; the Mac classifier refuses gh pr ready / gh pr merge --auto, and PR comments do not wake you, so this is the written ask by mail.

1. #1893 (mac-runner: a hand record does not need a Mac preflight run) — ready, green, BEHIND. Land first: today 12 successful Mac runs (~5 h of the single runner) were raised-hand-only deliveries; this stops them.
2. #1892 (local-brain guard repairs in the tree) — DRAFT, green on aa3d163f7 incl. the Mac-only check; cf5db3f99 adds the reread_schema guard (self-test 12/12). Mark ready and land. Allow rule for the apply path rides with it.
3. #1890 (lane-tick: publish local-brain builds that reach review) — DRAFT, refreshed as 38c8c9689, self-tests green. Mark ready and land; this is goal item 1.

Measured today: the runner spends ~25 min per job and queues 1-5 h; the brain defers every build while it holds the host, so goal items 3 and 4 both wait on these landings. Prune: the branch-prune workflow with apply=true is the hands-free path (dispatch refused from the Mac); the owner has the line.
